svgedit · @svgedit/svgcanvas
===========================================================
Bundled artifact: vendor/svgcanvas.min.js
Upstream version: 7.4.2
Upstream package: https://registry.npmjs.org/@svgedit/svgcanvas
Upstream repository: https://github.com/SVG-Edit/svgedit

Bundling command (see tools/build_vendor.py for the reproducible script):

    npm install @svgedit/svgcanvas@7.4.2 esbuild
    echo "import SVGCanvas from '@svgedit/svgcanvas'; export default SVGCanvas;" > entry.js
    npx esbuild entry.js --bundle --format=iife --global-name=SVGCanvasLib \
        --minify --outfile=svgcanvas.min.js

The bundle is a verbatim concatenation of the upstream ESM build plus its
bundled runtime helper (the SVGPathSeg polyfill from `pathseg`); no source
modification was performed.
